overviewParagraph: The Golden Designs Maxxus Bellevue 3-Person Low EMF FAR Infrared Sauna offers a spacious and rejuvenating wellness retreat right in your home. Designed for indoor use, this sauna is perfect for basements, master baths, or fitness rooms, providing a sanctuary for muscle relaxation, stress relief, and enhanced circulation. With 7 strategically placed Low EMF FAR infrared carbon heating panels and crafted from natural Canadian Hemlock wood, it ensures a safe and soothing environment. Enjoy the added luxury of an interior chromotherapy lighting system and Bluetooth connectivity, making each session a personalized escape.
